author: Brendan Nordstrom
bullets: Crime Raul Feliciano was previously convicted of rape and indecent assault on child under 14, court records show.

Raul Feliciano, an usher at Iglesia Cristiana Reno de Dios, faces charges of indecent assault and battery of a child under 14 years old and rape of a child in Milford District Court.
